items.title: Bad Wolves Singer Speaks Out After Band Is Dropped From Skillet Tour, Guitarist Quits Over Dolly Parton Cover
items.summary: A lot is going on with Bad Wolves. The Los Angeles metal band lost its vocalist last year when D.L. Laskiewicz departed to play in Falling In Reverse. Sara "Killboy" Skinner was announced as the new singer two months ago, and now Bad Wolves have been removed from an upcoming tour with Christian rock group Skillet, allegedly due to Skillet fans’ complaints about Skinner’s involvement. items.title: End It Frontman Commemorates Banana Man Saga With New Tattoo
items.summary: Do you remember the great Banana Man controversy of summer 2026? At the Baltimore hardcore band End It’s Toronto show in early June, frontman Akil Godsey called out a guy in the pit for “[wanting] attention” with his banana costume. "You don't get rewarded for doing that shit," he told the crowd. "He wanted the attention, and now he has it."
